finsights.brief: Holds more cash than debt on its balance sheet
6 analysts have revised their earnings downwards for the upcoming period

summary: Kuaishou Q2 revenue rose 1.4% YoY to 35.5B yuan; adjusted net profit hit 3.9B yuan with 11% margin; stock fell 4% to $37.8 near 52-week low.
Kling AI unit revenue surged 200%+ YoY to 850M yuan, leading global AI video commercialization as company expands AI across operations.
Gross margin compressed 410bps to 51.6% as costs rose; online marketing revenue up 4.4% while other services grew 18.5% amid macro headwinds.
Management warned H2 2026 faces pressure from weak consumer demand and heavy AI investment; aims to maintain positive free cash flow despite challenges.
Company holds 121.3B yuan in cash; pledged full-year shareholder returns exceeding 2025 levels through continued buybacks and dividends.
